text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had something I wanted to discuss regarding training,
so I went to see Nakayama Festa during dance practice—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! That part just now
was so sharp and cool!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"There wasn't a single delay even with such intense movements...!
Please, you have to teach me the secret!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're praising me way too much. You guys
can handle this much just as easily, can't ya?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Or what? You tryin' to catch me off guard
and drag me into a dance battle or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I'm not thinking about anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it might be pretty fun!?
It sounds like there's a lot I could learn from Nakayama-san, too!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan!?
choice_data_list: Are we having a dance battle?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The Trainer, huh?
...Looks like these guys have their minds set on it, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no, um,
I really didn't mean it that way...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
An opportunity like this doesn't come often, Kita-chan!
Since we're here, why don't we give it a shot?
Nakayama-san, please teach us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I-Is this really okay...?
Still, a chance like this hardly ever comes along...
so I'd like to ask as well, please!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh. ...If we're competing, I won't go easy on you, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dance battle between the three began.
To a randomly selected song,
each of them improvised their moves.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hum hum humm♪
Heeeeave... ho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
La-la-lan, la-la-la~♪
Right here... heave-ho.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Let's get this crowd even more hyped up! If you're gonna call this a battle, that is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In rhythm with the music,
Nakayama Festa's movements shift and adapt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was magnificent—a dance that seemed to express the song with her entire body!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is... the end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...You really are incredible!
To express the music so well even with an improvised dance...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And her body was moving so naturally...!
I want to see more and more of it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I told ya,
you're laying on the praise way too thick."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Of course Nakayama-san won!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haa.
Well, thanks for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two were moved far more than they were frustrated by the loss.
Nakayama Festa scratched her head
and quietly muttered, 'This makes it tough to play against you.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Your dance was so wonderful
it completely stopped me in my tracks...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Nakayama-san!
Could you teach us that dance from just now!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...I pass. Sounds like a pain.
choice_data_list: Still, the two of them are genuinely touched, too...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
............
...That's why, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nakayama-san! Please wait up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Nakayama Festa walks away briskly.
However, there is no sense of irritation
in her departing back."
